name: Honda GL1000 Gold Wing
engine: 999 cc liquid-cooled flat four, belt-driven cams, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: The original Gold Wing. Tough engine, but the cam timing belts must be changed by age, not looks.

add.title: Replace the timing belts
add.instructions: Replace both cam timing belts unless there's proof they were done recently. Set the crank to TDC first and follow the manual for the cam marks. Think about doing the water pump and thermostat while the front is open.
add.reason: Belts can look fine and still fail from age, and a snapped belt can do serious engine damage.

G: The four carbs are a common headache. Rebuild them as a matched set with updated seals and floats.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Old timing belts
known.what: Belts fail from age even with low miles.

known.title: Rusted exhaust
known.what: Mufflers and sometimes headers rust through.
